concerns.text: Spec FR-001 requires ingestion of raw text transcripts and associated labels. The plan only ingests pre‑computed sentence embeddings and creates a CSV with an empty `text` field, citing that raw transcripts are unavailable. This does not satisfy the functional requirement to ingest raw transcripts.

Spec FR-002 mandates extraction of lexical, syntactic, **and** semantic features. The plan extracts only the semantic coherence feature and sets all lexical/syntactic features to `null`, which fails to meet the requirement for full feature extraction.

Spec SC-002 specifies a success criterion of ≥ 1000 records after exclusions. The plan acknowledges this is unattainable and amends the criterion to “≥ 300 records”, documenting the limitation. This alteration diverges from the spec’s stated success criterion and leaves the original SC‑002 unfulfilled.
